nodes.text: haunts to you. By this beauty I [beg you], and by the coming joys
of youth: if I have endured the earth and a lowly husband
for your sake, if, when you were born, in Styx's stern stream
I armed you (and would it had been wholly!), take for a little while these safe
garments, which will do your spirit no harm. Why do you turn away your face?
